environment.description: Quarkus application deployed as AWS Lambda with Lambda Function URL. The function URL resource policy has a condition key 'lambda:FunctionUrlAuthType' set to 'AWS_IAM' on the function configuration. The InvokeFunction permission attached via resource-based policy specifies Principal: 'arn:aws:iam::ACCOUNT:role/ApiFrontendRole' with Condition StringEquals aws:PrincipalOrgID matching the organization. Note: the Lambda function URL IAM auth mode validates SigV4 signatures on incoming requests at the Lambda service layer BEFORE the request reaches the function code — unsigned requests receive HTTP 403 from the Lambda service itself, never reaching the Quarkus handler. The in-memory cache keying vulnerability still exists in the code but the attack surface requires a valid IAM credential with lambda:InvokeFunctionUrl permission scoped to this function ARN, which is restricted to the single internal frontend service role via the resource policy's Principal constraint and the SCP on the OU denying lambda:InvokeFunctionUrl to all principals except the approved role.
